cards.q: What is needed to travel beyond assigned training areas 0500–1700?
cards.a: A signed Troop Ticket ('Buck Slip') from a Drill Sergeant.

cards.q: Are taxis allowed during a Soldier's assigned duty-day shift?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: Can a VI+ Soldier buy alcohol off post?
cards.a: No. All MOS-I alcohol possession, purchase and use are prohibited except religious-ceremony consumption.

cards.q: Can Barton Field be used during darkness for casual recreation?
cards.a: No; only authorized PT, formations, supervised athletics, or approved MWR events.

cards.q: What is the barracks TV/monitor size and storage limit?
cards.a: 24 inches or smaller and must fit inside wall locker when stored.

cards.q: Which form inventories all barracks electronic devices?
cards.a: DA Form 4986 (High-Value Item Record).

cards.q: Who decides whether an otherwise unspecified device is authorized?
cards.a: Company Commander.

cards.q: Can a VI+ MOS-I Soldier drive or ride in a private/rental car by default?
cards.a: No. Company Commander authorization required.

cards.q: May IET Soldiers use motorcycles?
cards.a: No; strictly prohibited.

cards.q: May cadre give personal transportation outside official business?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: Are battle buddies required during personal PT?
cards.a: Yes, MOS-I Soldiers must use the battle buddy system.

cards.q: Are opposite-sex MOS-I Soldiers allowed alone together?
cards.a: No, including private/secluded areas.

cards.q: When may VI+ Soldiers form mixed-sex battle buddy groups?
cards.a: Only if same-sex buddy unavailable; mixed group must use a 2:1 ratio.

cards.q: What must off-post battle buddies do from start to finish?
cards.a: Sign out together, remain together, and sign in together.

cards.q: Which family members can serve as battle buddies?
cards.a: Non-MOS-I spouse, parent, or legal guardian; BN Commander may allow others.

cards.q: When does MOS-I leave-company sign-out apply during duty hours?
cards.a: When leaving company area except for class, PT or chow formations.

cards.q: Where must a Soldier go after final accountability formation?
cards.a: Assigned barracks unless on authorized pass.

cards.q: What must a Soldier wear until signed out on pass?
cards.a: The announced duty uniform.

cards.q: Who must carry the sign-out slip outside the brigade area?
cards.a: One member of the battle buddy team.

cards.q: List five categories required on a pass sign-out slip.
cards.a: Soldier names/ranks; sign-out time; expected return; buddy name/rank; cadre name/rank/contact.

cards.q: What happens to the sign-out slip after returning?
cards.a: Return it to the cadre in charge.

cards.q: May MOS-I Soldiers have intimate relationships while in training?
cards.a: No, including dating, inappropriate touching, and sexual relationships.

cards.q: May MOS-I Soldiers enter opposite-sex barracks rooms without authorization?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: May academically eligible VI+ Soldiers visit immediate family housing after duty?
cards.a: Yes, but must return for bed-check formation.

cards.q: Can a MOS-I Soldier move dependents or household goods to Fort Gordon?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: What is the normal PL15 academic-week range for Phase VI+?
cards.a: Generally Week 11 to graduation for courses fewer than 21 academic weeks.

cards.q: Does company-wide poor performance automatically delay an individual's phase-up?
cards.a: No; phase-up is individual and tied to training milestones.

cards.q: Who may accelerate an individual phase based on excellence?
cards.a: Battalion Command Team.

cards.q: Can a reclassified Soldier phase up solely on prior AIT time?
cards.a: No; all required 15th Signal Brigade milestones still apply, including Fort Gordon AFT.

cards.q: What happens to flagged or punished VI+ Soldiers?
cards.a: Revert to Phase V until flag/punishment ends or charges dropped.

cards.q: Can a Phase V Soldier under flag phase up?
cards.a: No; must be cleared first.

cards.q: What if an investigation later finds no misconduct?
cards.a: Soldier returns to the phase held before the flag.

cards.q: What are temporary phase suspension limits by cadre level?
cards.a: Drill Sergeant/Instructor 72 hours; Senior Drill Sergeant 7 days; Company Command Team 14 days.

cards.q: Who authorizes modification of privileges by a Battalion Command Team?
cards.a: Brigade Commander approval is required.

cards.q: After three formally counseled temporary suspensions, what can result?
cards.a: Permanent Phase V reduction, administrative flag and possible punitive action.

cards.q: What form records each phase suspension?
cards.a: DA Form 4856, with a plan of action.

cards.q: What badge must a phased-down Soldier wear immediately?
cards.a: Surrender current badge; wear reduced Phase V badge.

cards.q: How does a Soldier regain temporarily suspended privileges?
cards.a: Complete the corrective plan; higher echelon reviews if it is not met.

cards.q: Can one positive spot report offset major misconduct?
cards.a: No; it can offset one minor negative counseling, once, 1:1.

cards.q: What medical-hold/profile duration may permit VI+ privileges?
cards.a: Long-term medical profile or hold longer than 45 days, if otherwise eligible and in good standing.

cards.q: Can short medical profiles be stacked beyond 45 days to claim the exception?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: What is the standard Phase VI+ uniform in PL15?
cards.a: ACU, phase badge and CamelBak.

cards.q: When can a different hydration system replace an unusable CamelBak?
cards.a: Only with signed Company Commander/SDS ETP for an approved military-issued alternative.

cards.q: What is the VI+ non-duty-day formation time under PL15?
cards.a: 0800; duty-day PT/class/EOD formations are still required.

cards.q: May a VI+ Soldier wear civilian clothes on post off duty?
cards.a: Yes, IAW AR 670-1 paragraph 3-9.

cards.q: What new water option is authorized for VI+?
cards.a: May also carry civilian-approved water source IAW Brigade Blue Book.

cards.q: May VI+ Soldiers use civilian bedding?
cards.a: Yes, per unit policy.

cards.q: Where must VI+ duty-day breakfast and lunch be consumed?
cards.a: At approved Warrior Restaurants.

cards.q: May VI+ buy dinner on duty days and meals on non-duty days?
cards.a: Yes, IAW Enclosure 2.

cards.q: When is a DDEAMC cafeteria exception permitted?
cards.a: DS authorization with written buck slip, meal coinciding with medical appointment.

cards.q: Are off-post weekday passes a normal VI+ privilege?
cards.a: No. Off-post weekdays are not authorized.

cards.q: Are VI+ off-post weekend/holiday day passes possible?
cards.a: Yes, IAW Enclosure 2 and pass procedures; must obey training and buddy rules.

cards.q: Are VI+ off-post overnight passes automatically authorized?
cards.a: No; see §11 for extended-weekend exception requiring Battalion Commander approval.

cards.q: Who determines first duty-day formation and EOD accountability times?
cards.a: Company Commander.

cards.q: Can a Soldier depart for a weekend pass before all training and unit tasks finish?
cards.a: No. Weekend trainees must finish training and unit tasks before passes.

cards.q: Who can authorize VI+ off-post family-sponsored day passes?
cards.a: Company Commander; Soldier signed out by approved spouse, parent, grandparent, legal guardian, or in loco parentis.

cards.q: Who serves as battle buddy on a family-sponsored pass?
cards.a: The authorized family member.

cards.q: What must VI+ off-post pass counseling include?
cards.a: Safety/accident prevention as applicable, briefings, emergency contact information.

cards.q: Where may Soldiers meet family for sign-out?
cards.a: Battalion Staff Duty Office or Company Operations/CQ.

cards.q: May family enter a trainee's barracks room?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: When may a VI+ Soldier enter a hotel or motel?
cards.a: Only when accompanied by an authorized family member.

cards.q: When may VI+ Soldiers get an overnight pass on an extended weekend?
cards.a: Only with Battalion Commander approval.

cards.q: Who can authorize overnight emergency pass with verified family emergency?
cards.a: Battalion Commander, with verified Red Cross message.

cards.q: Is ordinary leave normally authorized for IET Soldiers?
cards.a: No; extraordinary-case exception approved by Battalion Commander.

cards.q: Who approves emergency leave for an immediate-family emergency?
cards.a: Battalion Commander under AR 600-8-10.

cards.q: Can violating PL15 result in UCMJ action?
cards.a: Yes, violations may lead to UCMJ punishment or adverse administrative action.

cards.q: Which PL15 version is currently represented by these questions?
cards.a: April 1, 2026; it supersedes the February 14 version. Confirm no later local update.

cards.q: Can VI+ freely visit the Eisenhower Club or BOSS HQ?
cards.a: No; Eisenhower Club only for official functions, BOSS HQ not authorized.

cards.q: Are MWR sports bars/lounges authorized for VI+?
cards.a: No, including Heroes Lounge.

cards.q: Can a VI+ Soldier enter training areas for leisure?
cards.a: No; official events are an exception.

cards.q: Can VI+ use Barton Field after dark?
cards.a: No, except unit PT/official events and other §7.c exceptions.

cards.q: Are VI+ Soldiers authorized to use the outdoor pool?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: When may VI+ Soldiers use the indoor pool and TORCH Gym?
cards.a: After training/unit tasks complete and on non-duty days.

cards.q: May VI+ Soldiers use MWR gyms other than TORCH?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: Are the Education Center and library open to VI+?
cards.a: Yes; subject to duty/other location-specific restrictions.

cards.q: When may VI+ use Wilkerson Lake, the TASC range, or Dinner Theater?
cards.a: On non-duty days, subject to other applicable rules.

cards.q: When may VI+ use Five Star Lanes, Eisenhower Lakes golf, disc golf, or horse stables?
cards.a: On non-duty days, subject to applicable facility rules.

cards.q: When may VI+ use Alternate Escapes Café/Domino's?
cards.a: After training/unit tasks complete and on non-duty days.

cards.q: Can VI+ shop at the Class VI store or Gate 1/5 shopettes?
cards.a: No; those locations are not authorized at Phase VI+.

cards.q: When may VI+ access PX, other PX stores, food court, Starbucks, and commissary?
cards.a: After training/unit tasks complete and on non-duty days.

cards.q: When may VI+ use Mini Mall, AAFES Troop Store, or its restaurants?
cards.a: After training/unit tasks complete and on non-duty days.

cards.q: When may VI+ use Meme & Bobo's or Burger King?
cards.a: After training/unit tasks complete and on non-duty days.

cards.q: When are VI+ food delivery services authorized?
cards.a: After training/unit tasks complete AND on non-duty days, per Enclosure 2.

cards.q: Is the Amazon Drop Box/package pickup authorized for VI+?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: Can VI+ normally use DDEAMC Starbucks?
cards.a: No.

cards.q: What is the DDEAMC cafeteria rule despite the matrix saying NO?
cards.a: No normal access; §9.f allows case-by-case DS written slip with medical appointment.

cards.q: Are on-post religious centers permitted for VI+?
cards.a: Yes; duty/class conflict requires a Buck Slip.

cards.q: What governs VI+ off-post religious activities?
cards.a: Brigade Policy Letter #13, per the Enclosure 2 note.

audit.scope: All Phase VI → VI+ promotion standards and applicable MOS-I / Phase VI+ provisions; excludes MOS-T/Hold Company and unrelated higher-phase rules.
audit.limits: PL15 does not enumerate WTBD task stations, local knowledge exam item bank, or full Army Song text. Confirm local evaluation sheet and any superseding orders.
